text:
alice.dev: quick idea after the outage — do we want the API gateway to be the source-of-truth for retry budgets and throttles, and have the edge proxy only enforce streaming-level flow control?
ben.platform: +1 to centralizing budgets. Gateway already knows tenant quotas and billing units. avoids duplicate accounting.
carla.runtime: worried about resource exhaustion at the edge. if gateway rejects, fine; but if gateway allows and edge gets hammered we still OOM.
dave.sre: can we split responsibilities? gateway handles soft budget decisions and global counts, edge keeps local per-connection caps and sheds load gracefully.
emma.obs: need clear telemetry surface either way. add headers like `X-RW-Retry-Decision` + trace id so we can correlate allowed/blocked paths.
frank.arch: proposal sketch: gateway returns an explicit token when it grants retry budget: `Retry-Grant: <token>`; edge checks token on reconnects/hedges. If token missing, edge treats request as non-retriable.
carla.runtime: token idea ok but we must avoid cryptographic lookups per-request. prefer short-lived signed token (HMAC) so edge can verify cheaply.
ben.platform: agree on signed token. also we should fail fast: gateway refuses additional hedging attempts once global budget exhausted, returns 429 w/ body `{"reason":"retry_budget_exhausted"}`.
dave.sre: what about streaming aborts mid-response? we can't always cancel long-running inferences at the edge when budget changes. need a soft-fallback: mark stream as non-retriable and let client decide.
alice.dev: important: preserve client-perceived idempotency semantics. we shouldn't silently convert a retriable call into a non-retriable one. header toggle + trace event seems best.
emma.obs: add a metric `gateway_retry_grants_total{tenant,model}` and `edge_hard_aborts_total` — surface both in console dashboards.
frank.arch: rough state machine (pseudo):
```
# Gateway
if want_retry and tenant_budget > 0:
  issue token = sign({ts, tenant, budget_id})
  tenant_budget -= 1
  return 200, header: Retry-Grant: token
else:
  return 429, header: Retry-Allowed: false

# Edge
if request has Retry-Grant token and verify(token):
  allow hedging / internal retries
else:
  mark request as non-retriable, route accordingly
```
carla.runtime: implementable. caveat: clock skew -> short TTL and allow small grace window.
ben.platform: security note: rotate HMAC keys regularly, expose key id header for quick verification.
dave.sre: rollout plan idea: 1) gateway emits `Retry-Grant` header but edge ignores -> collect telemetry; 2) edge starts enforcing token on a canary fleet; 3) full rollout + key rotation.
emma.obs: I'll add dashboards and an alert for `edge_hard_aborts_total > baseline * 5` during rollout.
deploy-bot: CI: PR #3921 — gateway/retry-token: tests pass, integration pending. https://git.internal/r/3921
alice.dev: thanks folks. action items: ben to write spec for token payload, carla to prototype cheap verify in runtime, emma to wire metrics, frank to draft rollout steps. I'll sync with PM after prototype. :thumbsup:
